description.value: Caffè Artigiano is a pioneering Vancouver specialty coffee brand with over 25 years of history and international barista competition recognition, known for award-winning latte art and its own Burnaby roastery producing 100% Arabica blends. This West Pender Street location is one of 25-plus cafes across BC and Alberta, serving specialty coffees, house-made baked goods, and artisanal food made from organic and seasonal ingredients with no artificial additives. The brand has recently expanded into cocktail-serving Cafe-Bars, making it a stop suited to cyclists looking for a quality sit-down coffee or a light meal.
